thread:
Maria: heads-up — after the qlora PTQ onboard for cyclone5b we're seeing clustered repeats for short instruction prompts in hosted canary :eyes:
Maria: example: input "Summarize: why renewables matter" -> model keeps outputting repeated phrases like "...renewables matter. renewables matter. renewables matter." then truncates
Maria: quick reproducer (canary):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "cyclone5b-qlora-ptq-v1", "prompt": "Summarize: why renewables matter", "max_tokens": 80, "temperature": 0.7 }
```
Aj: I can repo locally with the same quant weights, running now with our inference harness
Aj: initial run reproduces the clustered repetition at short prompts (~8/20 runs)
Aj: logs show attention spikes on the first few tokens
Kevin: can you paste raw tokens+logits for a failing run? might be kv/rotary scaling mismatch after PTQ
Aj: dumping tokens+logits for a failing run:
```
TOKS: [101, 234, 678, ...]
LOGITS: [6.1, 6.05, 6.07, 6.06, 6.05, 6.05, 6.05]
NOTE: logits plateau at same high value across steps
```
Hana: this smells like a runtime default mismatch (we recently changed runtime default top_k=50 for PTQ cost tuning)
Maria: runtime canary config: batching=auto, top_k=50, kv_cache=enabled, quant-kernel=fused-attn-ptq
Aj: trying two quick local experiments: disable kv_cache; set top_k=5
Aj: experiment 1 (kv_cache off) -> repeats still present but rate dropped (40% -> 15%)
Aj: experiment 2 (top_k=5) -> repetition down to ~3%, outputs look reasonable
Kevin: plausible. PTQ can amplify small biases; fused-attn-ptq kernel may produce overconfident logits. lowering top_k is a cheap mitigation
Hana: can we push a canary variant with same weights but runtime override top_k=8 and kv_cache disabled for 10% traffic?
Maria: yes — also add gated metric: repetition_ratio = count(repeats >=3)/requests
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary/cyclone5b-qlora-ptq-topk8-kvcache-off -> 10% traffic at 2025-06-18T14:20:00Z
Kevin: parallel: I'll roll back a small percentage to float16 (non-PTQ) to compare quality/perf delta
Aj: local perf note: top_k=8 + kv off increases p50 by ~18ms but within SLO
Maria: capture eval-run on metric suite: perplexity, repetition_ratio, semantic-similarity proxies (BLEU/ROUGE)
Hana: adding dashboard alert: repetition_ratio > 0.05 for 5m
Maria: TL;DR: short-term mitigation = runtime top_k=8 + kv_cache off; longer-term: investigate fused-attn-ptq kernel and rotary scaling in quantization
Kevin: assigning eng-ml -> @Aj, @Kevin, @Maria for root cause; @Hana to own rollout monitoring
Aj: will open GH issue with reproducer, logs, and kernel suspicion
Maria: thanks — will add links to issue and canary run in ticket when ready :thumbsup:
